### Nordson Corporation Announces Earnings Release and Webcast for Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2025


November 6, 2025


WESTLAKE, Ohio--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Nordson Corporation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nordson.com&esheet=54352698&newsitemid=20251105419837&lan=en-US&anchor=Nordson+Corporation&index=1&md5=26cbf82a022e2112e1e43b494e2209b0) **** (Nasdaq: NDSN) today announced it will release fourth quarter and fiscal year 2025 earnings on December 10, 2025, after the close of the market. Nordson will host its quarterly webcast on:


Date:


Thursday, December 11, 2025


Time:


8:30 AM ET


Link to listen:


[https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/211633413](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Furl.us.m.mimecastprotect.com%2Fs%2FbyUICL9GnOuRWRL1AHYTnCyBabS%3Fdomain%3Dgoogle.com&esheet=54352698&newsitemid=20251105419837&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F211633413&index=2&md5=d708e7962b1405b98a2e9d3b02ef5ea7)


Investors who are interested in listening to the webcast, but are not able to participate during the scheduled time, can access the replay by visiting[Nordson's investor website](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.nordson.com%2Fhome%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54352698&newsitemid=20251105419837&lan=en-US&anchor=Nordson%27s+investor+website&index=3&md5=9b82c832a9f9e82382958a97147022d0) .


Nordson Corporation is an innovative precision technology company that leverages a scalable growth framework through an entrepreneurial, division-led organization to deliver top tier growth with leading margins and returns. The Company’s direct sales model and applications expertise serves global customers through a wide variety of critical applications. Its diverse end market exposure includes consumer non-durable, medical, electronics and industrial end markets. Founded in 1954 and headquartered in Westlake, Ohio, the Company has operations and support offices in over 35 countries. Visit Nordson on the web at[www.nordson.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nordson.com&esheet=54352698&newsitemid=20251105419837&lan=en-US&anchor=www.nordson.com&index=4&md5=2499429345054cb4affa909a6e59ebcf) ,[linkedin/Nordson](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2F10456%2Fadmin%2Ffeed%2Fposts%2F&esheet=54352698&newsitemid=20251105419837&lan=en-US&anchor=linkedin%2FNordson&index=5&md5=917a0792c1afae7e0167bb7d9c306119) , or[www.facebook.com/nordson](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2Fnordson&esheet=54352698&newsitemid=20251105419837&lan=en-US&anchor=www.facebook.com%2Fnordson&index=6&md5=9001bc4076bc87ac01e9968d396ef371) .
